# Exclusive Shipping Solutions (Pty) Ltd

EXCL Shipping, also shown on this site as Ex Factory, is Exclusive Shipping Solutions (Pty) Ltd. The company was founded in 2014. The head office is at Main Road, East London, South Africa. The team works with in-house agents across South Africa.

## What we export

Proudly South African goods, sourced from the factory or farm. Products listed on the site:

- Brown onions
- Potatoes
- Popcorn
- Apples and pears
- Super maize meal
- White maize flour
- Yellow maize flour
- Yellow corn
- White corn
- Grit A & B, coarse maize grit, 50kg bags
- Brown teff flour
- White and brown sugar
- Chocolate eclairs
- Naks, assorted flavours, 50 x 20g bales
- Noodles, assorted flavours, 50 x 20g
- Energy drinks, 24 x 250ml and 4 x 250ml, all flavours available
- Thai long grain parboiled rice, 1 ton sling bags, 100% non-broken and 15% broken
- Bananas, Angola origin, 18kg boxes

If a product is not listed, the site says we will source it ex-factory. We also handle shipping and relocation (road, sea and air), immigrating and relocation, and customs import and export.

## Markets

Buyers in SADC countries, the UAE and worldwide.

## How to request a quote

No prices are shown on the site. Tell us the product, quantity and destination. You get a clear quote and terms. After you confirm, we handle the order from the factory to you.

Call, WhatsApp or email. We will call you back.
